features.feature: Category-aware dirty gate policy: material_source_changes / fixture_changes / unexpected_dirty_files are blocking
Category-aware dirty gate policy: koala_metadata_changes / runtime_artifact_changes / declared_artifact_changes pass with audit notation
Single shared policy table as source-of-truth (no divergence across gates)
validate side-effect guard (validation-executor) consumes the shared policy table
TEST pre-check consumes the shared policy table
DONE gate consumes the shared policy table
Audit notation / logging when a passing category is allowed through
Regression proof that blocking semantics for material/fixture/unexpected remain intact
Gate oracle / renderer separation: DONE pre-check git-working-tree row must follow stable id/status/detail/hint/source/blocking contract (story-lifecycle.md)

Runtime artifact paths (.koala/activity.jsonl, .koala/runtime/, etc.) must be excluded from material-hash / treated as non-blocking even when dirty (runtime-artifact-registry semantic, testing-infra.md)
Audit write failure must surface as gate block (fail-closed, not silent pass) per testing-infra fail-closed principle
Registry-vs-policy invariant: DIRTY_GATE_POLICY entry count must equal DIRTY_WORKTREE_CATEGORIES length (extensibility guard)
Import isolation: gate consumers must import from dirty-gate-policy.ts, no inline category checks in story-advance.ts or validation-executor.ts
